game.title: Sabi Words

game.tagline.text: Find di hidden words before time finish.

game.howto.1.text: Swipe for di letters for straight line, any side, to circle di hidden word. Word fit run front or back.

game.howto.2.text: You no want swipe? Tap di first letter, then tap di last letter. For keyboard, use arrow keys move, press Enter or Space to mark where e start and where e end.

game.howto.3.text: You dey stuck? Di lantern go show di first letter of one word, e cost 10 coins. Coins na just for fun, you go win dem when you finish puzzle. Press H for hint.

game.howto.4.text: Beat di clock: if half of di time still remain you go get 3 stars, if one-fifth remain na 2 stars, and 1 star if you just finish. If time don finish, you lose di round.

game.howto.5.text: Pick one of di six word packs for menu. Daily Puzzle na di same one for everybody today: your first try na im count, di next ones na practice. Press P to pause.

menu.dailyUsed.text: Today puzzle don start. If you play again, na practice.

menu.dailyDone.text: Today score: {score}. If you play again, na practice.

error.pack.body.text: Check your data or network, then try again. Nothing lost.

persona.osas.name: Osas

persona.osas.1.text: Kóyo! Welcome to my stall. Make we find some words.

persona.osas.2.text: Take your time, look for every side.

persona.osas.3.text: E dey there! You see am!

persona.osas.4: That one long o. Well done!

persona.osas.5.text: No be word, but you try. Swipe again.

persona.osas.6: Make I light lantern for you.
persona.osas.7: Time dey run o. Five seconds!

persona.osas.8.text: Three stars! Every letter dey him place.

sw.banter.win.1.text: Correct work! Every word don find im place.

sw.banter.win.2.text: Well done! Even my signboard no clean reach this.

sw.banter.lose.1.text: No wahala. Look again, di words go show.

sw.banter.lose.2.text: E near reach. Rest small, try another puzzle.
